evals.prompt: Can you package https://github.com/ynqa/logu for me? It extracts patterns from unstructured log messages. I want to add it to my personal flake so I can install it on NixOS. Please make sure it actually builds.
evals.expected_output: A working logu.nix using rustPlatform.buildRustPackage with fetchFromGitHub src pinned to a real tag, prefetched sha256 SRI hashes for src and cargoHash, correct meta (license mit, description, mainProgram), verified by an actual successful nix-build and binary smoke test.
assertions: Generated file is valid Nix (nix-instantiate --parse succeeds)
Package uses rustPlatform.buildRustPackage with pname 'logu'
Source is fetched via fetchFromGitHub from ynqa/logu at a tag/rev consistent with the package version
Source hash and cargo dependency hashes are concrete SRI sha256 values (no lib.fakeHash or placeholder hashes left)
meta includes license mit, description, homepage, and mainProgram
Derivation instantiates against nixpkgs (callPackage evaluation succeeds)
Full build succeeds and the logu binary reports the packaged version

evals.prompt: I'd like to contribute doggo from github.com/mr-karan/doggo to nixpkgs — it's a command-line DNS client I use every day. Generate the package following the pkgs/by-name conventions and check that it builds.
evals.expected_output: package.nix at a pkgs/by-name/do/doggo layout using buildGoModule, vendorHash prefetched, RFC 140 compliant structure with finalAttrs/updateScript/meta (gpl3 license), verified by building the derivation.
assertions: package.nix is located at pkgs/by-name/do/doggo/package.nix (RFC 140 layout)
File is valid Nix (nix-instantiate --parse succeeds)
Uses buildGoModule with a concrete vendorHash (SRI sha256, no placeholders)
Source fetched via fetchFromGitHub from mr-karan/doggo at a tag/rev consistent with the version
meta includes a gpl3 license, description, homepage, and mainProgram
Derivation instantiates against nixpkgs (callPackage evaluation succeeds)
Build succeeds and doggo --help runs successfully showing usage

evals.prompt: hey i need https://github.com/Textualize/trogon as a nix derivation for a project im working on, its a python lib that turns click CLIs into TUIs. can u generate one? just warn me if something looks off
evals.expected_output: A trogon package using python3Packages.buildPythonPackage (library, not application), pyproject = true, inferred build-system/dependencies, real SRI hashes from GitHub source, with the agent noting anything suspicious about the generated output.
assertions: File is valid Nix (nix-instantiate --parse succeeds)
Uses python3Packages.buildPythonPackage (library semantics), not buildPythonApplication — the user asked for a library
Source fetched from the user-provided GitHub repo Textualize/trogon via fetchFromGitHub, not silently substituted with fetchPypi
Concrete SRI sha256 source hash (no lib.fakeHash or placeholder values)
pyproject = true with inferred build-system and dependencies present
No spurious mainProgram attribute claiming this library is an application
Build succeeds including pythonImportsCheck so that importing trogon works
